note: Forward-only paper comparison: 100/0, 75/25, 50/50 (control), 25/75 probability/EV weights. All use the same frozen seven-market pool, 48-hour horizon, prices, costs and one-market-per-match top ten. Primary results include ALL selections, with STRICT/PROVISIONAL shown separately. First eligible usable capture per fixture only; no historical backfill or repeated stakes. Win rates include Wilson intervals. Profit differences pair each verified usable fixture with control, using one unit for a selection and zero if skipped. Weekly block bootstrap intervals are exploratory, unadjusted for three comparisons, and unavailable before six weeks/100 paired fixtures. Selection-cohort Brier scores do not prove improved forecasts. Readiness requires 300 verified usable fixtures, six ISO weeks, 80% resolved coverage and 100 settled picks per weighting. No automatic production change. Confirm any chosen weighting on a later untouched period.
